summary.text: Commander Legends gathers short tales of commanders from many worlds, among them Kaalia, whose congregation is massacred by shadowy beings, Riku, who splits himself into two reflections, and Karador, who is slain in a great battle by a rival warchief.
In Drakkus, monsoons drive humans into fungal forests where the mycoids declare war on them, until Ghave turns the tide and reclaims his forest home.
Elsewhere planeswalkers face their own dangers, as Garruk Wildspeaker confronts Liliana Vess in a dark plane and Sheoldred predicts that many worlds will bow to Phyrexia, with Mirrodin first.
